title: 과목별 최저·최고·평균 점수
desc:
과목별 최저점, 최고점, 평균(소수 첫째 자리 반올림)을 과목 알파벳 순서로 조회하세요.

열: subject, min_score, max_score, avg_score
solution:
SELECT subject, MIN(score) AS min_score, MAX(score) AS max_score, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS avg_score
FROM exams
GROUP BY subject
ORDER BY subject;
